title: Yeah. Even though it was wet, I still had fun.
scene: 下雨还跑出去玩，回来爸爸数落。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You went out in the rain?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Yeah. Even though it was wet, I still had fun.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Just my feet. The puddles were worth it.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I feel fine. Can I go out again tomorrow?
